status: proposed, not a registered or funded competition

gates.name: Source provenance
gates.requirement: Official outcome and operator price snapshots; content hashes, revisions, rights and independent reconciliation.

gates.name: Point-in-time integrity
gates.requirement: Feature availability and quote timestamps at or before forecast; forecast before kickoff; frozen forecast artifact and code hash.

gates.name: Sealed chronological test
gates.requirement: Train earlier, tune later, seal final later weeks; keep all legs of the same game together. No random-row split.

gates.name: Power and calibration
gates.requirement: Predeclare effect size and cluster-aware power calculation; at least 30 independent clusters for exploratory bootstrap only, not proof of sufficient power; publish reliability bins and coverage.

gates.name: Predictive improvement
gates.requirement: Paired out-of-sample log-loss improvement versus simultaneous proportional no-vig market baseline; 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound greater than zero. Brier and calibration also reported.

gates.name: Economic robustness
gates.requirement: Executable quoted payouts, pushes/voids and costs; positive 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound on net return per unit; repeat under predeclared price-delay stress; publish drawdown and exposure.

gates.name: Selection and dependence
gates.requirement: Register all variants and pair tests; Holm-adjust all valid prespecified family p-values at family-wise alpha 0.05; estimate joint outcomes directly for combos, not products of marginals.

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.requirement: Freeze finalist, complete untouched prospective paper trial using predeclared power and stopping rules; reproduce independently; fail closed on missing evidence or drift.

reward_policy: Proposed noncash recognition only: Gold, Silver and Bronze research badges for eligible top three within each matched market track. No funded prize or payout is authorized.
